headline: Israel's eToro to Cut Staff in Second Layoff Round of 2026
summary: Israeli multi-asset brokerage platform eToro announced plans to trim its workforce for the second time in 2026. The firm offers trading in equities, ETFs, crypto assets, and derivatives.
why: eToro is a prominent international social investment network providing retail trading infrastructure across asset classes.

impacts.name: eToro
impacts.why: Restructuring expenses and headcount reductions reflect cost management measures at eToro.
